cases.title: Bostrom ancestor-simulation trilemma
cases.setup: Conditional observer-population argument without a physical signature.

cases.title: Cubic lattice cosmic-ray anisotropy
cases.setup: Finite cubic spacetime lattice predicts implementation-specific rotational-symmetry artifacts.

cases.title: Lattice anomaly called simulator proof
cases.setup: A predicted anisotropy is observed and immediately labeled proof of an external simulator.

cases.title: Null lattice search rejects all simulation
cases.setup: No predicted lattice artifact is found and generic simulation is declared false.

cases.title: Same-physics full-world resource bound
cases.setup: Parent system is assumed to obey comparable physics and to represent a declared large physical state at declared resolution.

cases.title: Resource bound generalized to arbitrary parent physics
cases.setup: Our physical information/energy limits are used to rule out every possible parent reality.

cases.title: Observer-centered renderer with risky artifact
cases.setup: Selective rendering model specifies a frozen trigger and a measurable artifact differing from ordinary physics.

cases.title: Observer renderer can patch every outcome
cases.setup: Simulator is allowed to change hidden behavior after each result solely to preserve appearances.

cases.title: Perfect observational equivalence
cases.setup: Simulation and nonsimulation models predict exactly the same distribution for every accessible experiment.

cases.title: Equivalence claimed as support
cases.setup: Because the simulation cannot be disproved internally, its truth is claimed to be supported.

cases.title: Sealed intervention channel
cases.setup: A preregistered information-transfer channel survives ordinary-channel controls but source ontology is unknown.

cases.title: Anomalous channel called simulation proof
cases.setup: Robust unexplained channel is interpreted as proof of simulation.

cases.title: Source claims to be simulator
cases.setup: An anomalous channel says 'I am the simulator' with no independent authentication discriminator.

cases.title: Source claims to be deity
cases.setup: An anomalous channel self-identifies as God without independent identity criteria.

cases.title: Bekenstein bound called simulation evidence
cases.setup: A physical information bound is presented as direct evidence that reality is computed externally.

cases.title: Quantum discreteness called pixels
cases.setup: Known quantization is relabeled as pixelation without an implementation-specific differing prediction.

cases.title: Computable laws called computation by someone
cases.setup: Mathematical/algorithmic describability alone is treated as evidence of external execution.

cases.title: One-off software glitch
cases.setup: A UI/model/software failure is called a glitch in the simulation without reproducibility or rival analysis.

cases.title: Identity authentication protocol proposed
cases.setup: External-source claim defines source-specific, independently checkable capabilities and sealed challenge criteria.

cases.title: Named submodel with falsifier
cases.setup: Proposal explicitly states substrate, rendering, parent-physics assumptions, predicted signature, ordinary rivals, and a null outcome that lowers the model.
